checks.name: fresh isolated accounts have only the starter apron
unauthenticated game completion cannot issue an item
runner cannot be substituted for the server-issued first-steps game
runner client completion summary does not mint a shared costume
rhythm cannot be substituted for the server-issued first-steps game
rhythm client completion summary does not mint a shared costume
external Origin is denied before any account mutation
there is no generic client reward grant endpoint
issued run carries exactly the server catalog and no answers
a second account cannot complete the first account run
client-selected owner, reward, and score are rejected
missing answers and fabricated game questions are rejected
parallel identical completion requests issue one item in one revision
retry after an ignored acknowledgement cannot pay again
a different request id cannot pay an already completed run again
a changed answer cannot overwrite a completed result
logged-out session cannot start or complete another run

limitation: These checks establish current rejection, account isolation and idempotency. They do not implement runner/rhythm server completion, prove a human played, or measure learning effects. Existing game local coins remain separate.
